Hero.Title: Immigration and work permits in geneva
Hero.Description: Clear support for L, B, C permits, ANobAG cases and relocation in Romandy.

Presentation.Title: Swiss immigration and permit coordination
Presentation.Subtitle: Clear steps, reliable follow-up
Intro: We help entrepreneurs, executives and families secure their move to Switzerland with a pragmatic, compliant approach.
We clarify the options (L/B/C permits, ANobAG, company incorporation) and coordinate with cantonal authorities and social insurance funds.
We handle the key steps so you keep a clear view of timelines, documents and costs.
Services: Status review and mobility strategy (EU/EFTA or third-country)
Coordination of residence and work permits (L, B, C, G)
ANobAG files and social insurance registration
Company incorporation and employment contracts when needed
Tax and payroll follow-up to stay compliant

Strengths.Title: Clear diagnosis
Strengths.Desc: Rapid assessment of your situation and success likelihood before unnecessary costs.

Strengths.Title: Complete file
Strengths.Desc: Preparation and verification of documents to limit authority requests.

Strengths.Title: Local coordination
Strengths.Desc: Follow-up with cantonal offices, AVS funds and relevant partners.

Strengths.Title: Social and tax compliance
Strengths.Desc: Alignment of ANobAG, payroll and tax duties for a smooth setup.

Strengths.Title: Post-arrival support
Strengths.Desc: Assistance with renewals, employer changes or company creation.

Presentation.LongFormTitle: detailed approach and deliverables for immigration and work permit support
LongForm: Our immigration and work permit support support starts with a precise review of your flows and operating model so we can define a clear scope, realistic timeline, and priorities that make a measurable difference. In , we work with expats, executives, families and entrepreneurs who want to secure immigration and permits without adding internal complexity or losing visibility on key decisions. The core deliverables typically cover L/B/C/G files, ANobAG and authority coordination, with an ongoing focus on data quality and traceability. We embed requirements tied to SEM guidance, cantonal rules and AHV obligations from the beginning to avoid late-stage fixes and compliance risk. Depending on your context, we organize the collection of contracts, passports, diplomas and attestations and implement simple routines to keep records complete and reliable.

We rely on checklists, timelines and administrative tracking when they add clarity, while staying compatible with your current stack if you prefer a hybrid approach. Every engagement begins with a short diagnostic that clarifies constraints, expected gains, and decision points, then translates into a written action plan. We favor direct communication and regular checkpoints so trade-offs remain visible and timelines stay under control. Our methods adapt to activity cycles, operational peaks, and cantonal constraints, with a pragmatic follow-up rhythm. The goal is to deliver smooth relocation, compliance and timeline visibility while reducing the administrative load on your teams.

When external stakeholders are involved, we coordinate exchanges and prepare the synthesis materials they expect. We explain options, impacts, and trade-offs clearly so decisions stay aligned with your strategy. Costs are driven by complexity, transaction volume, and coordination needs; we make those drivers explicit early on. We provide reporting formats suited to your governance, with concrete indicators and actionable recommendations. When the context changes (growth, funding, restructuring), we adjust the setup without starting over.

The engagement stays centered on your priorities: compliance, efficiency, and reliable day-to-day execution. We document decisions in a clear way so each choice is defensible and continuity is preserved. Finally, we outline the next steps so the post-engagement phase is smooth and improvements remain durable.
